features: Free online scan from Fixlight: enter up to 25 site addresses and get a report of each home page's accessibility problems, checked in a real browser with axe-core (WCAG 2.2 A/AA rules), with why each matters and how to fix it, worst first. Confirm by email; no account. The report link is kept 90 days and prints to PDF.
title: Fixlight free accessibility scan
